scenario.description: One marked vehicle enters northbound on I-25, leaves at the Arapahoe interchange, runs west on Arapahoe Road and north up South Yosemite Street, waits 30 minutes under the Yosemite Street bridge and leaves north on I-25, among heavy freeway traffic with a wide spread of speeds, dense arterial traffic heavy in vans and trucks, residential commuters on the west and south edges, and an incident closing 5 of the 6 northbound lanes for 3 minutes. Written by CarlaControl/scripts/make_arapahoe_scenario.py; edit that, not this.
